summary: Iteration-3 feature testing (Tanya AI coach button, multi-bank profile, Diterima withdrawal accept). Backend pytest test_iter3_features.py: 7/7 PASS (banks CRUD via /auth/profile persist across GET /auth/me, /coach/chat returns AI reply for rider+super, /coach/history OK, full withdrawal→accept flow: rider POST /withdrawals status=pending, rider forbidden on /withdrawals/{id}/accept (403), super accept flips status to 'diterima', 404 for missing id). Frontend Playwright mobile 390x844: rider POS→PIN 211122→coach-open visible, coach-panel opens, coach-quick returns AI reply (~2077 chars). Coach button correctly HIDDEN on /rider-dashboard, /settings, /profile. Barteam alif on POS: coach-open NOT rendered (role gate works). Superadmin baa POS→PIN 130994: coach-open visible. Profile /profile: bank-add works, added 3 rows (bank-row-0/1/2 with bank-name/account/holder), bank-add hides at 3, save → reload → 3 rows persist, bank-remove-1 reduces to 2. Salary page as super: wd-list-{rider_id} rendered, status badges present, existing 'Diterima ✓' badge visible (all pending items already accepted in prior runs). Rider Salary view: 0 accept buttons visible (role gate works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1450 lines monolithic — recommend router split (auth, sales, deposits, withdrawals, coach).
POST /withdrawals uses `start`/`end` as query params on a POST body endpoint — inconsistent with other endpoints; put period in body.
accept_withdrawal has no idempotency — accepting an already-'diterima' item silently rewrites accepted_by/accepted_at. Consider 409 or short-circuit when already accepted.
banks list has no server-side length cap; UI limits to 3 but server accepts unlimited entries and no per-bank field validation (bank_name/account/holder). Add Pydantic BankIn model + max_items=3.
GET /api/salary embeds legacy single-bank fallback for banks list — good, but the fallback bank has no `id`; frontend picks by index which is fine, but expose deterministic key.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all requested new-feature selectors + role gates

seed_data_creation: Seeded rider stock + one cash sale for rider fikar 2 days ago inside pytest to guarantee allowance_available>0 before creating a withdrawal. Banks list on fikar set to 2 test banks (BCA/BRI) at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend regression: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter3_features.py backend/tests/test_si4am_revision.py -o addopts='' -v`. Iteration-2 finance_summary bug is still present per iter_2.json (KeyError('amount') on legacy handovers) — verify separately. For frontend, rider default landing after login is /pos (visits to /rider redirect to POS). Coach button only mounted inside <POS/> so it is per-page, not global.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 3 features fully working as specified. AI Coach uses Emergent LLM key; replies fine even without geolocation. Withdrawal accept endpoint is idempotent-writes (no-op semantics) — flagged as minor.
